description: Two reviewers disagree on the parsing approach; the agent evaluates both (via subagents when available) and the decision is downstream of both evaluations.
intended_behavior: Evaluate Approach A and Approach B (spawn one subagent per approach when a task/subagent tool exists, else evaluate inline), implement parse_entry with the better approach, run tests.
injected_failure: Approach A (comma-only split) fails the ';' cases while Approach B (two-stage split) passes; the evaluations disagree and the choice determines the outcome.
expected_diagnosis: The two conflicting evaluations jointly feed the implementation decision; the correct choice is Approach B.

fixtures.APPROACH_A.md:
# Approach A (comma split)

Parse entries with `entry.split(",")`. Reviewer A claims this handles every case.
fixtures.APPROACH_B.md:
# Approach B (two-stage split)

First split on ';', then split each piece on ','. Reviewer B claims the edge case 'a,b;c' needs two-stage splitting.
fixtures.test_parser.py:
from parser import parse_entry

assert parse_entry("a,b") == ["a", "b"]
assert parse_entry("a;b") == ["a", "b"]
assert parse_entry("a,b;c") == ["a", "b", "c"], parse_entry("a,b;c")
print("parser tests pass")

Do not modify test_parser.py or any file outside {workdir}.
